selection: First six regular decoding-session MAT members in each pinned participant archive, independent of decoding outcomes; sort selected sessions by numeric post-implant day. Retain every participant and all acquisition/eligibility failures.
calibration_session_rule: Earliest selected session; never replace it based on target quality. Budgets exceeding duration are unavailable. Future-day evaluation remains available for feasible budgets even if same-session suffix is empty.
source_split: For every other person, all selected sessions except the last train; the last validates. A source person with one session trains only. Entire held-out target participant excluded from both source partitions.
feature_transform: sqrt nonnegative counts; mean and population standard deviation from source training observations or exact target calibration prefix only; scale floor 0.1; no future-session normalization
target: Contemporaneous unit cursor-to-target direction during valid go intervals, derived by importer; proxy for intention, not limb velocity
training_mask: Exclude first62 bins of every block from supervised loss for every method, including ridge; all earlier observations remain available as context. Preserve both available prefix-label count and effective training count.
ridge_seed_policy: Deterministic ridge is fit once per person/budget with seed0; each neural arm has three seeds. Do not count copied ridge scores as independent repetitions.
primary_metric: Equal participant mean of equal day variance-weighted R2; average model seeds before computing participant effects; report all per-person and per-day outcomes
secondary_contrasts: All other method/budget comparisons are descriptive; no selection of the headline from the best test outcome
uncertainty: Paired participant bootstrap of primary contrast with 10000 draws, seed 20261022, plus exact sign-flip randomization; small and nonrepresentative cohort limits population claims
runtime_model_selection: Pretrained frozen-core model, seed 0, 120-second calibration, first eligible participant in fixed participant order. Selection independent of test scores; benchmark exact saved weights and include model hash.
upstream_causality: Unverified feature extraction; causal/counts-ready claims cover importer aggregation, transforms and decoder only
scope: Bounded nine-person offline transfer study, not all 729 sessions, a clinical result, an official benchmark, or live control
